$comment: Built-in application profiles (Phase 4.2). Templates only: they reference catalog ids, are validated at load (src/engine/applications/builtin.ts) and are never edited by the UI. 'defaults' are ticked when the profile is active; 'optional' are shown unticked as recommendations. Device profiles are activated by the device answers, not by a checkbox.

profiles.name: Core Essentials
profiles.description: The universal baseline for every computer: browser, media player, archives, verified copying, attended remote support, password manager and the Visual C++ runtimes. Every app stays individually removable.

profiles.name: Everyday Essentials
profiles.description: Home use: a PDF reader by default, with email, video calls, messaging, cloud storage and photo viewing to choose from.

profiles.name: Gaming
profiles.description: Steam and the Epic Games Launcher, with the other launchers, Playnite and Discord to choose from. No accounts, logins or game libraries are configured.

profiles.name: General Developer
profiles.description: A lean developer baseline: Git, Visual Studio Code, Python and Node.js LTS. Editors, AI tools, containers and network tools are optional.

profiles.name: Network Engineer / Developer / Technician
profiles.description: A complete personal power-user workstation: the General Developer baseline plus AI and development tools, networking and remote administration, diagnostics, USB tools, downloads and synchronisation. VPNs, sync and download tools are installed only, never configured.

profiles.name: Music Enthusiast
profiles.description: Local music libraries and playback: MusicBee as the library manager by default, with other players, editors, converters and streaming apps to choose from (VLC is already in Core Essentials).

profiles.name: iPhone / iPad
profiles.description: Activated by an iPhone or iPad under Mobile devices & ecosystem: Apple Devices is recommended and ticked; Apple Music, iTunes and iCloud stay optional.

profiles.name: Android
profiles.description: Activated by an Android phone or tablet. Basic USB file transfer needs no extra software, so nothing is ticked; manufacturer tools are optional.

profiles.name: Laptop
profiles.description: Portable computers: BatteryInfoView to check battery wear, with manufacturer update tools for Dell and Lenovo to choose from.

profiles.name: Touchscreen / 2-in-1
profiles.description: Pen and touch: Xournal++ for handwritten notes and PDF annotation, with Whiteboard and Joplin to choose from.
